scope: Clear update progress, favorites, and audio controls.

topics.title: Pause or play from any screen
details: Press Control+Alt+P to pause or resume radio and podcasts. This works from any screen in Companion, including Options.

topics.title: Choose background audio
details: Audio stops when you return to the main menu.
To keep listening, turn on Keep audio playing in the background in Radio or Podcasts options. It is off at first. The setting applies to both.

topics.title: Go straight to a favorite
details: While browsing, say Go to and the saved name. For example, Go to My news opens that favorite. This also works in the web browser menu.

topics.title: Short update progress
details: You hear progress in steps of five percent. Say Status or Update status to hear just the percent. This works while the file is saved and while setup runs.
When setup is done, the app says "Installation complete, restarting Voice Companion." It reads all of this message. Then it opens the app again.

topics.title: Hear the full goodbye
details: When you exit, the app says "Shutting down. Goodbye." It waits for the full message to play. Then it closes.

topics.title: Favorites in the browser menu
details: The menu now says Go to favorite, New favorite, Rename favorite, and Delete favorite. Your saved pages stay in place.
